BR-16

BRAKE SYSTEM — Front Brake

REMOVAL OF CYLINDER
(See page BR-14)

1. DISCONNECT BRAKE HOSE FROM BRAKE TUBE AND CYLINDER
(a) Using SST and a spanner, disconnect the brake tube from the hose.
SST 09751-36011
(b) Use a container to catch the brake fluid.
(c) Remove the clip from brake hose.
(d) Disconnect the brake hose from the cylinder.

2. REMOVE CYLINDER
(a) Hold the sliding bushing and remove the cylinder installation bolt.
(b) Lift up and push out the cylinder from the torque plate pin.

3. REMOVE FOLLOWING PARTS:
(a) Anti-squeal shim
(b) Brake pads
(c) Anti-rattle springs
(d) Pad guide plates
(e) Pad support plate

DISASSEMBLY OF CYLINDER
(See page BR-14)

1. REMOVE SLIDING BUSHING AND BOOT
